description: Fail over the primary node of every ElastiCache (Redis OSS) replication group, cluster mode disabled, tagged FIS-Ready=True, and wait until the former primary has recovered as a replica

triggerPrimaryFailover.description: Run the SSM Automation document that calls TestFailover on each tagged replication group and waits for the failover and the former primary's recovery

parameters.documentParameters: {"AutomationAssumeRole": "arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR SSM AUTOMATION ROLE NAME>", "tagKey": "FIS-Ready", "tagValue": "True"}
